channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: Aman's entry into Puerto Rico with Amantaru inside the $2 billion-plus Esencia development in Cabo Rojo leads the period. Other wins include a Hilton dual-brand hotel opening in San Juan's Convention District, a Marriott City Centro in Ponce, a $41.6 million federally funded Hyatt Place loan approved by the fiscal board in Ponce, and Aeroméxico restoring the San Juan–Mexico City route in June 2027. The risk side is a stalled economy (New York Fed: flat activity index since 2023, 6.2% unemployment), an economists' survey rating the fiscal board poorly, and the Encanto Restaurants Chapter 11 after Yum! Brands ended its franchise, with about 2,600 jobs lost. On energy, LNG supply to San Juan remains unsettled while the governor seeks new suppliers, PREB approved Genera compliance funds, and DOE renewed grid emergency orders through February 2027.
